name: Exp_XPVT
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the XPVT (Volume Price Trend) custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position sizing is managed via a money management module with multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XPVT（量价趋势）自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈。仓位管理通过资金管理模块实现，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XPVT指标的趋势跟踪交叉系统。入场条件为：当指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时产生买入信号，当Ind下穿Sign时产生卖出信号，具体通过比较相邻两根K线的Ind与Sign值关系来判断交叉。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时的平仓机制（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于可用保证金减亏损、基于余额减亏损、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择计算方式。策略使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置，默认为1即前一根已收盘K线，这有助于避免未来数据偏差。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的单指标交叉趋势跟踪系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following crossover system based on the XPVT (Volume Price Trend) indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell signal is generated when Ind crosses below Sign, detected by comparing Ind and Sign values across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus a reverse-signal close mechanism where an opposing crossover triggers position closure. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, free margin minus loss, balance minus loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with MMMode for calculation method selection. The strategy uses SignalBar (default 1) to specify which bar confirms the signal, using the previous closed bar to avoid look-ahead bias. The overall logic is clear and represents a typical single-indicator crossover trend-following system.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制交易风险占比
parameters.description_en: Risk ratio or lot size controlling position sizing

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/扣除亏损后的保证金/扣除亏损后的余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: fixed lot or margin ratio

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平空仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平多仓）

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：跳价成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 适用价格类型：收盘/开盘/最高/最低/中位/典型/加权等

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认K线索引，1为前一根已收盘K线
parameters.description_en: Signal confirmation bar index (1 = previous closed bar)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于量价趋势指标的交叉信号，易于理解和维护
资金管理模块功能完善，支持五种仓位计算模式，适应不同风险偏好
支持独立控制开仓和平仓方向，灵活性高，可单独启用买入或卖出逻辑
使用SignalBar=1确认已收盘K线信号，有效避免未来数据偏差
包含IsNewBar新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on volume-price trend crossover signals, easy to understand and maintain
Comprehensive money management module supporting five position sizing modes to accommodate different risk preferences
Independent control over buy/sell open and close directions, offering high flexibility for partial strategy deployment
Uses SignalBar=1 to confirm signals on closed bars, effectively avoiding look-ahead bias
Includes IsNewBar new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率市场环境下适应性差
缺少点差过滤机制，在大幅点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖自定义指标XPVT，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行，增加了部署复杂度
没有多时间框架确认机制，仅依赖单一指标单一周期信号，假信号风险较高
缺乏最大持仓数量限制和最大回撤保护等风控措施
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit in points rather than ATR-based dynamic calculation, poor adaptability across different volatility environments
No spread filter mechanism, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during wide spread conditions
Depends on custom XPVT indicator, EA fails to run if the indicator file is missing, increasing deployment complexity
No multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, relying solely on single indicator single timeframe signals with high false signal risk
Lacks risk controls such as maximum position count limits and maximum drawdown protection
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同市场波动率环境
增加点差过滤和多时间框架确认机制，减少假信号和不利成交
添加最大持仓数量限制、最大回撤保护和连续亏损后暂停交易等风控措施
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add spread filter and multi-timeframe confirmation mechanisms to reduce false signals and unfavorable fills
Implement risk controls such as maximum position count limits, maximum drawdown protection, and trading pause after consecutive losses

risk_points: 固定止损1000点和固定止盈2000点的比例虽为1:2，但在低波动市场可能止损过大，在高波动市场可能止盈过小
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能因大幅滑点造成额外损失
没有最大回撤保护和连续亏损控制机制，极端行情下可能持续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP ratio of 1:2 may result in excessive SL in low-volatility markets and insufficient TP in high-volatility markets
No spread filter may cause additional losses from significant slippage in low-liquidity markets
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss control mechanism, risking sustained losses during extreme market conditions
